blurb: Guests can rent a floating cottage powered by solar energy, located in a calm inlet of the Atlantic Ocean about 100 metres from shore. The cottage includes a rowboat for transportation to and from land and sightseeing around the bay. It features an open concept with a twin daybed, queen loft mattress, bathroom with shower and electric flushing toilet, kitchen with mini-fridge and propane stove, and a covered front porch with bench seating and swim ladder.
